source_name: NLB Group — Kosovo market page (NLB Banka Pristina)
why_relevant: Group-maintained profile of the Kosovo subsidiary — links to local reports, states market share and positioning; a reliable pointer to keep entity identifiers and links current.

source_name: NLB Banka sh.a. Prishtinë — Raporte vjetore / Pasqyrat financiare
why_relevant: Local Albanian-language IFRS annual reports and financial statements of the NLB Kosovo subsidiary; the reconciliation counterpart to the group's segment numbers and the source of Albanian terminology for the glossary.

source_name: ProCredit Holding AG — Investor Relations / reports
why_relevant: Frankfurt-listed parent of ProCredit Bank Kosovo. Group annual and quarterly reports explicitly discuss Kosovo's contribution to the South Eastern Europe segment (loan portfolio growth, SME lending, digital/direct-banking model, green loans) and are BaFin/ECB-supervised disclosures.

source_name: EQS News — ProCredit Holding AG issuer page (ad-hoc + corporate news + reports)
why_relevant: German statutory ad-hoc/regulatory news distribution for ProCredit; timestamped inside-information releases (guidance changes, capital, funding facilities explicitly naming Kosovo) available in both DE and EN, with a stable per-issuer feed URL.

source_name: ProCredit Bank Kosovo — Annual reports (Uploads/Data/Files PDF store)
why_relevant: Kosovo-entity IFRS annual reports that let group segment figures be reconciled to the local balance sheet (2024: EUR 1.3bn loan portfolio, EUR 936m deposits per the 2024 report); PDFs are directly linkable.

source_name: Türk Ekonomi Bankası (TEB) — Faaliyet Raporları / Annual Reports & investor presentations
why_relevant: TEB A.Ş. (BNP Paribas / Çolakoğlu JV) is the Turkish arm of the TEB Group behind TEB Sh.A. Kosovo; Turkish annual reports carry subsidiary/affiliate ('iştirakler', 'bağlı ortaklıklar') sections and BRSA-consolidated investor presentations that occasionally detail the Kosovo unit.

source_name: TEB Sh.A. Kosovo — Annual Reports (teb-kos.com)
why_relevant: Local entity of the BNP Paribas/TEB Holding JV; annual report PDFs on a predictable WordPress uploads path, documenting capital (EUR 24m share capital), shareholding chain and digital-channel rollouts in Kosovo.

source_name: KAP — Kamuyu Aydınlatma Platformu (Turkish Public Disclosure Platform)
why_relevant: Statutory disclosure venue for Turkish issuers relevant to this cell (T.C. Ziraat Bankası A.Ş., TEB A.Ş.). Its structured 'bağlı ortaklıklar' (subsidiaries) item type and notification search allow systematic detection of Kosovo-related material events, capital injections and subsidiary lists.

source_name: T.C. Ziraat Bankası A.Ş. — Integrated Annual Reports (Entegre Faaliyet Raporu)
why_relevant: Ziraat operates in Kosovo through a country directorate and branches (Prishtina, Prizren, Peja, Ferizaj) rather than a separate local legal entity, so the Turkish parent's integrated annual report is the primary — and possibly only — published source of Kosovo network, branch-count and international-operations detail.

source_name: Ziraat Bank Kosova (Prishtina branch / country directorate) website
why_relevant: Local Kosovo web presence of the Ziraat branch network, referenced inside the parent's annual reports; likely carries Albanian-language product/branch information and possibly local financial statements required by CBK.

source_name: Banka Kombëtare Tregtare (BKT) — Investor Relations
why_relevant: BKT (Tirana, wholly owned by Çalık Holding since 2009) is the parent of Banka Kombëtare Tregtare Kosovë JSC. BKT's IR section holds group financial reports and rating/funding material; it is the main disclosure route above the Kosovo entity, and Albanian-language pages give the local terminology.

source_name: Çalık Holding — Annual Reports and BKT Kosova sector page
why_relevant: Ultimate parent of BKT Albania and BKT Kosova. Its integrated annual reports contain a finance-sector chapter with BKT Kosova commentary (including digital-banking investment claims), and the dedicated BKT Kosova sector page is a stable pointer to group-level narrative about the Kosovo bank.

source_name: SeeNews — company/news coverage of parent-group Kosovo subsidiary results
why_relevant: Regional financial wire that systematically reports quarterly results of foreign-owned Kosovo bank subsidiaries (e.g. NLB Kosovo net profit by quarter), often extracting the country figure from group filings faster than the group publishes an English country breakout. Useful as a cross-check and as an early-warning index of which group filings contain Kosovo detail.

source_name: MarketScreener — RBI / ProCredit investor-presentation republication
why_relevant: Aggregator that mirrors issuer investor presentations and impact reports with timestamps; useful as a redundancy/backfill channel when an issuer removes older PDFs, and as a discovery feed for newly published decks containing SEE/Kosovo slides.

source_name: financialreports.eu — NLB filings mirror
why_relevant: Structured third-party index of NLB regulated filings and financial statements; convenient machine-readable entry point and archival redundancy for the group reports that carry the Kosovo segment.

source_name: BQK — Sistemet e Pagesave (Payment Systems section, Central Bank of the Republic of Kosovo)
why_relevant: BQK is the owner and operator of Kosovo's only interbank clearing/settlement rail (KIPS/Sistemi Ndërbankar i Pagesave). This section is the authoritative publisher of rail design, participant lists, operating rules and scheme-level change (instant payments, ISO 20022, SEPA readiness).

source_name: BQK — Skema e funksionimit të Sistemit Ndërbankar të Pagesave (KIPS operating scheme page)
why_relevant: Describes the KIPS clearing scheme itself: high-value and retail clearing, priority/individual/mass payments, Kos-Giro, direct debit, securities leg, ISO 20022 basis, and the direct-participant roster (11 commercial banks + CBK + Treasury/MFLT + KPST). Rail-level detail that no bank annual report contains.

source_name: BQK — Raporti i Stabilitetit Financiar (Financial Stability Report) payments chapters
why_relevant: FSR editions carry a payment-systems chapter with KIPS volumes/values, card and terminal infrastructure, and e-banking penetration — the recurring narrative layer over the raw statistics.

source_name: BQK — News / Lajme (governor and deputy-governor statements on payment infrastructure)
why_relevant: BQK press items are where instant-payment rollout, non-bank PSP access to the payment system, fintech licensing counts and SEPA-readiness milestones are first announced — earlier than any report.

source_name: BQK — Rregullore për qasjen e ofruesve të shërbimeve të pagesave jo-banka në sistemet e pagesave (non-bank PSP access regulation)
why_relevant: Rail-access rulebook: defines which non-bank payment institutions and e-money institutions may join the interbank system and under what conditions — the regulatory precondition for new switch/processing entrants.

source_name: BQK — Lista e institucioneve financiare të licencuara/regjistruara (register of licensed financial institutions)
why_relevant: Authoritative actor map: enumerates licensed payment institutions and e-money institutions alongside banks. Snowballing this list yields the full population of non-bank payment/processing actors serving Kosovo.

source_name: Quipu GmbH (ProCredit group processor & card personalisation centre, Kosovo hub)
why_relevant: Quipu is a third-party card processor whose personalisation/processing centre sits in Kosovo and serves 25+ financial institutions; it was the first processing centre in Kosovo to issue contactless. Its news feed announces switch upgrades, e-commerce gateway launches and 3DS/EMV migrations at rail level.

source_name: The Payments Association — Quipu/Compass Plus Kosovo contactless processing announcement
why_relevant: Trade-press record linking the Kosovo processing centre to the TranzWare (Compass Plus) switch platform — evidence of the underlying card-switch technology stack serving Kosovo issuers/acquirers.

source_name: Shoqata e Bankave të Kosovës (Kosovo Banking Association) — The Kosovo Banker
why_relevant: The industry association publishes The Kosovo Banker (sq/en) where banks, BQK and vendors discuss instant payments, card acceptance, SEPA and processing partnerships — a rich pointer to actors and rail-level initiatives.

source_name: BIS Central Bankers' Speeches — Governor Ahmet Ismaili / BQK speeches
why_relevant: BIS mirrors BQK governor speeches verbatim, including payment-infrastructure roadmaps (instant payments, open banking, fintech access to rails). Stable, well-indexed archive that survives BQK site changes and bot defences.

source_name: European Payments Council / SEPA accession coverage — European Western Balkans
why_relevant: Tracks Kosovo's SEPA pre-application (Dec 2024) and the regional accession sequence (Albania, Montenegro, North Macedonia admitted 2025) — the single biggest pending change to Kosovo's euro payment rails.

source_name: German Economic Team — Kosovo SEPA accession analysis
why_relevant: Quantifies the rail-level economics of SEPA accession for Kosovo (~EUR 55m/yr in transaction-cost savings, split remittances vs trade payments) — the analytical baseline advisors and banks cite.

source_name: Balkan Insight — Kosovo SEPA delay reporting
why_relevant: Investigative coverage of why Kosovo's SEPA accession stalled (court review, political impasse) — political-risk context that scheme and rail timelines depend on, rarely stated by BQK itself.
